description: This file implements the core functionality of TorchDynamo's frame conversion system, transforming Python frames into FX graphs, handling analysis, bytecode transformation, guard management, cache logic, error handling, and integrating with torch.compile(). It defines classes, functions, and mechanisms for capturing, transforming, and optimizing Python code in the context of PyTorch's dynamic compilation system.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: A helper class to track and manage seen code objects for cache validation and cycle detection.

classes.name: ConvertFrameBox
classes.description: Data class for holding optional error flags related to frame conversion.

classes.name: ConvertFrameAssert
classes.description: Main class responsible for asserting and managing the conversion of Python frames into FX graphs, including handling caching and error conditions.

classes.name: DynamoOutput
classes.description: Represents core output data from a single Dynamo run, including guards, generated code, and metadata.

classes.name: BackendInput
classes.description: Data structure encapsulating the core information needed to pass a graph to a backend. Includes fx GraphModule, example inputs, FakeTensorMode, and context mappings.

classes.name: GraphRuntimeEnv
classes.description: Runtime environment for generated graph execution, including bytecode, import sources, globals, closure, and references.

classes.name: GraphCaptureOutput
classes.description: Structured output capturing data relevant to a graph capture, including export metadata, traced code, and external references.

classes.name: CaptureOutput
classes.description: Aggregates the output of a full graph capture, including the captured graph, backend input, and additional verification data.

classes.name: FrameInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a code frame, including code object, globals, locals, builtins, closure, and argument defaults.

methods.name: FunctionType fx_forward_from_src_skip_result( src: str, globals: dict[str, Any], co_fields: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None )
methods.description: Monkey patch of FX's forward_from_src to prevent infinite loops, also skips code analysis for generated code.

methods.name: list[str] log_dynamo_start(code: CodeType, skip: int = 0)
methods.description: Logs the start of a Dynamo frame conversion, extracting and filtering traceback frames.

methods.name: Callable[_P,_T] preserve_global_state(fn: Callable[_P, _T])
methods.description: Decorator/context manager for saving/restoring global states such as grad mode, random states, and monkey patching fx.forward_from_src.

methods.name: bool has_tensor_in_frame(frame: DynamoFrameType)
methods.description: Checks whether the current frame has torch or numpy tensors, used to determine if tracing should proceed.

methods.name: None exception_handler( e: Exception, code: CodeType, frame: Optional[DynamoFrameType] = None, export: bool = False, )
methods.description: Handles exceptions during frame conversion, attaching execution records and augmenting messages.

methods.name: Callable[_P,_T] maybe_cprofile(func: Callable[_P, _T])
methods.description: Wraps a function with profiling if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: Callable[_P,_T] cprofile_wrapper(func: Callable[_P, _T])
methods.description: Performs profiling of a function, saves stats, generates SVG visualizations, and uploads data if applicable.

methods.name: CompileId get_compile_id( frame_state: dict[str, Union[int, FrameStateSizeEntry]], )
methods.description: Generates a unique compilation ID based on frame state, tracking invocation count and prior context.

methods.name: ConvertFrame convert_frame( compiler_fn: CompilerFn, hooks: Hooks, package: Optional[CompilePackage] = None, )
methods.description: Main function to convert a code frame into an FX graph, managing caching, retries, and error conditions.

methods.name: ConvertFrameAssert convert_frame_assert( compiler_fn: CompilerFn, one_graph: bool = True, export: bool = False, export_constraints: Any | None = None, package: Optional[CompilePackage] = None, )
methods.description: Factory function to create a ConvertFrameAssert instance for full frame conversion.

methods.name: RemovableHandle register_bytecode_hook(hook: BytecodeHook)
methods.description: Registers a hook to intercept or modify bytecode generated during Dynamo tracing.

methods.name: DynamoTracerOutput trace_frame( code: types.CodeType, globals: dict[str, object], locals: dict[str, object], builtins: dict[str, object], closure: tuple[CellType], compiler_fn: CompilerFn, tf_mode_stack: list[torch.overrides.TorchFunctionMode], one_graph: bool, speculation_log: SpeculationLog, instructions: list[Instruction], code_options: dict[str, object], *, export: bool = False, export_constraints: Any | None = None, frame_state: Optional[dict[str, Union[int, FrameStateSizeEntry]]] = None, distributed_state: Optional[DistributedState] = None, package: Optional[CompilePackage] = None, )
methods.description: Performs tracing of a code frame, producing DynamoTracerOutput with instructions and graphs.

methods.name: ConvertFrameReturn _compile( code: CodeType, globals: dict[str, object], locals: dict[str, object], builtins: dict[str, object], closure: tuple[CellType], compiler_fn: CompilerFn, one_graph: bool, export: bool, export_constraints: Any | None, hooks: Hooks, cache_entry: Optional[CacheEntry], cache_size: CacheSizeRelevantForFrame, frame: Optional[DynamoFrameType] = None, frame_state: Optional[dict[str, Union[int, FrameStateSizeEntry]]] = None, *, compile_id: CompileId, skip: int = 0, package: Optional[CompilePackage] = None, convert_frame_box: Optional[ConvertFrameBox] = None, )
methods.description: Coordinates compilation of code into FX graphs, including handling retries, code validation, guard generation, and error handling.

methods.name: ConvertFrame
methods.description: Class encapsulating logic for full frame conversion, integrating backend compilation and error handling.

methods.name: None replay(filename: str)
methods.description: Function to replay a recorded execution from a file, wrapping compilation and execution with debugging info.

methods.name: int first_real_inst_idx(code: CodeType)
methods.description: Identifies the first instruction index in code after RESUME, considering Python version.

methods.name: ConvertFrameProtocol
methods.description: Protocol defining the callable interface for frame conversion functions with specified arguments.

methods.name: CatchErrorsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper class that adds error catching and handling around a frame conversion callback.

methods.name: CatchErrorsWrapper catch_errors_wrapper( callback: ConvertFrameProtocol, hooks: Hooks )
methods.description: Function returning a wrapped version of a callback with error handling, preserving the signature.
